detail:
verdict=deploy-ready; posted and transitioned; caveats:
  - Injection used the admin send endpoint (processMessageForAdmin -> processTenantMessage), which is the same code path as the live integration endpoint apart from apiTokenId; the real Epic-facing /api/integration/hl7 route was not exercised.
  - No captured Epic SIU in the repo actually carries a populated ZCS-5 - every fixture on disk has 'ZCS|BEFORE|N|ORSCH_S14'. The field position was taken from the ticket's sample text, so if Epic puts ASA in a different ZCS component than ZCS-5-1 in the live feed this validation would not catch it.
  - Numeric-prefixed forms exercised end-to-end were 2, 3, 4 and 5, plus legacy Roman 'III'. ASA_1 and ASA_6 are covered only by the existing unit tests, not by an injected message.
  - The red check swapped only the SIU processor class; the AsaStatus enum, the operations.asa_status column and the merge line in DefaultHL7ProcessingContext stayed in place, so it isolates the ZCS-5 extraction rather than the whole changeset.
  - Downstream consumers of asaStatus that landed in later commits (ProcedureRiskService pancreatectomy risk, the admin ASA edit endpoint and the Debug Operation tab) were not exercised beyond confirming OperationDTO serialises the field.
